summary: Approve. The change is strictly additive: one new file, orchestrator/test/util.test.mjs (76 lines, 15 tests), with zero modifications to util.mjs, package.json, package-lock.json, CI or existing tests. I independently re-derived every assertion against the real source at util.mjs:60-64 (truncate) and util.mjs:70-78 (slugify) rather than trusting the worker — including the three most error-prone ones: slugify(\"café\") -> \"caf\" (trailing dash from é is trimmed), the 41-char -> 40-char trim-before-slice quirk whose asserted value \"a-b-...-s-t-\" is the genuine truncated result ending in \"-\", and truncate(0, 10) -> \"\" via the falsy guard. All correct. Every spec-enumerated behavior for both helpers is covered, the longer-than-max case is asserted as a full exact string as required, and the two quirks the spec forbids encoding (omitted max producing a NaN count, negative max) are correctly absent from the suite and instead documented in DEC-003 alongside the slugify TypeError. File conventions match planner.test.mjs exactly (ESM, flat top-level test(), node:test + node:assert/strict only) and the path matches the npm test glob, so the tests genuinely execute. Tests are deterministic: pure string inputs, no fs/network/timers/clock/cwd dependence. npm test exits 0 with all 20 pre-existing tests still green. One non-blocking observation: git status shows M .ai/TASKS.json and untracked .ai/DECISIONS/DEC-003-* and .ai/RUNS/20260911-134615/, which is stricter-reading noise against AC#1 — these are orchestrator bookkeeping files written by the system after the commit, not product-code edits, and the feature diff itself is exactly one added file with zero modifications.
